title: Shopify App Store Developer Leads Input
description: Find Shopify apps by keyword and extract developer leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Terms matched against app handles (e.g. email, upsell, reviews, wholesale, subscription).

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run.

maxPerKeyword.title: Max per keyword
maxPerKeyword.description: Cap apps taken from each keyword (exact and prefix matches first).

minReviews.title: Minimum reviews
minReviews.description: Drop apps with fewer reviews than this. Zero keeps everything.

qualifiedMinReviews.title: Qualified review bar
qualifiedMinReviews.description: Reviews at or above this, with a support email, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

requireEmail.title: Only apps with a support email
requireEmail.description: Skip apps whose listing has no public developer support email.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Recommended at volume so the App Store does not rate limit a single IP.
